title: flightdeck app-manifest
description: The flightdeck app-manifest contract (v1, spec §6). Six required/optional core fields plus the optional 'storage', 'auth', and 'alerts' opt-ins, nothing else — CI supplies the image, never add an image field.

name.description: DNS-safe service name; becomes the URL host (https://<name>.fd.robertpuffe.com) and all AWS resource names. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must start with a letter; max 16 characters (dev stacks append "-dev", so this leaves room under the 32-char target-group name limit). "wake" is reserved for the platform scaler endpoint.

port.description: Port the container listens on. Unprivileged only (>=1024) — the container runs as non-root (contract rule 6). Must equal the port the process binds.

healthcheck.description: HTTP path that must return 200 within 30s of container start. Absolute path — must start with '/'. Keep it dependency-free (no DB calls).

cpu.description: Fargate task CPU units. Must be paired with a valid 'memory' value — see the cpu/memory pair rules enforced below.

memory.description: Fargate task memory in MiB. Must form a valid Fargate cpu/memory pair — see the cpu/memory pair rules enforced below.

env.description: Non-secret config only — NO secrets, tokens, or credentials; v1 has no secret support. Flat map of string keys to string values. STORAGE_BUCKET and the COGNITO_* keys are reserved — the platform injects them when 'storage: s3' / 'auth: cognito' are set; do not define them here.

storage.description: Opt in to a private, encrypted S3 bucket for this environment (dev and prod get separate buckets). Grants the app's task role access to exactly that bucket and nothing else. The bucket name arrives via the STORAGE_BUCKET env var — do not set that key yourself in 'env'. 's3': data is destroyed with the stack. 's3-retained': the bucket is versioned (90-day noncurrent retention) and survives a stack teardown — terraform cannot delete it while it holds data. Either value also switches the service to stop-then-start deploys so at most one task ever writes (see docs/contract.md).

alerts.description: Optional log-pattern alerts. Each entry becomes a CloudWatch Logs metric filter on the app's log group plus an alarm that fires on any matching log line within 5 minutes and notifies the platform's alert email. Use for failure signatures worth waking a human for (e.g. a replication sidecar's error lines). Patterns use CloudWatch Logs filter syntax and are passed through verbatim.

name.description: DNS-safe suffix for the alarm and metric-filter names. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter; max 32 chars; unique within the list.

pattern.description: CloudWatch Logs filter pattern matched against every log line, e.g. "level=ERROR" (quotes included for term matching).

auth.description: Opt in to a Cognito user pool for this environment (dev and prod get separate pools) with a public PKCE app client and hosted login UI. Identifiers arrive via the reserved COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, COGNITO_DOMAIN, and COGNITO_ISSUER env vars — do not set those keys yourself in 'env'. No AWS SDK calls or client secret involved; verify tokens against the issuer's JWKS. User accounts are destroyed with the stack (see docs/contract.md).

memory.description: Valid memory (MiB) for cpu=512: 1024-4096 in 1024 steps.
Valid memory (MiB) for cpu=1024: 2048-8192 in 1024 steps.
